reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `nodepools.karpenter.sh` changes v1beta1 → v1", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing NodePool objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration must re-write all objects and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all NodePool objects (storage version migration) and update status.storedVersions.

proposed.statement: The NodePool CRD (nodepools.karpenter.sh) storage version changes from v1beta1 to v1, so existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration rewrites them and status.storedVersions is updated before a later release removes v1beta1.
